seo.titel: Tarra Lanzilli — ceremonies and breathwork in Sappemeer
seo.beschrijving: Personal truffle, mushroom, and Mother Nature ceremonies and breathwork guided by Nathalie in Sappemeer. Warm, safe, and at your own pace.

hero.kop: What grows beneath the surface shapes everything above
hero.tekst: Sometimes you notice that something old is still steering you. A pattern, restlessness, or belief that once protected you, but now holds you back. I help you meet those layers in calm and safety.

intro.label: Do you recognize this?
intro.kop: You're not broken. You grew around what was there.
tekst: Many of our patterns originate in early childhood. Not because something is wrong with you, but because as a child you learned how to adapt and endure.
When talking alone is no longer enough, breathwork and plant ceremonies help you drop out of your head and feel what is asking for space within your body.

punten.titel: You understand it in your mind, but your body holds on
punten.tekst: You know where your patterns come from, yet the same restlessness, pressure, or tension keeps returning.
You carry a lot and take care of those around you, but find it hard to truly slow down and let go.
You are looking for a safe, low-stimulus sanctuary to meet old layers at your own pace.

beeld.alt: Roots of an old beech tree spreading naturally into the forest floor among fallen autumn leaves.

tekst: From my own experience I know how freeing it is to stop fighting old layers and meet them safely instead. At my practice in Sappemeer I walk alongside you, calm and grounded.

portret.alt: Portrait of Nathalie, smiling, with long dark hair

ceremonies.tekst: I work with plants and with the breath. Each opens a different door. Not sure what suits you best? We will explore that together during a calm introduction.

ervaringen.label: Participant stories
ervaringen.subtitel: Short impressions from people who went before you. Read their full stories on the stories page.

cta.kop: Shall we get to know each other?
cta.tekst: You don't have to decide anything yet. In a no-obligation conversation, we get to know each other and feel together what suits you best.
